opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment of the Court of Appeals is vacated, and case is remanded to the United States District Court for the Eastern District of California with directions to dismiss the action as moot. United States v. Munsingwear, Inc., 340 U. S. 36 (1950).
